headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts Anew as Nevish Line Reaches Parity
war_summary: The past three hours brought a violent resurgence to the Weathered Expanse, where fighting reignited with six rapid base transitions across Spirit Watch and Wightwalk, leaving five Colonial bastions, one Warden foothold, and three desolate ruins in no-man's-land. Along the Nevish Line, Colonial forces pushed their tally to an even four-four deadlock against the Wardens, accompanied by a staggering surge in bloodshed that claimed well over a thousand fallen per side in the latest hour alone. Linn of Mercy witnessed three further base exchanges at Lathair and Outwich Ranch, keeping Wardens clinging to two fortified posts against eight Colonial holdings and a single unclaimed site. Mooring County suddenly flared into sharp contention at The Wind Hills with three base transitions in two hours, whereas Callahan's Passage cooled considerably from its previous carnage. Stonecradle's frantic base turnover has momentarily paused, and Dead Lands is enduring sharply accelerating casualty rates as the central front girds for fresh turmoil.
